summary: Proposed ten bounded OpenCode packets for private Nisi v0.2: each adds nonoverlapping tests, harnesses, manifests or pure modules with fail-before/pass-after acceptance, no edits to the 225 frozen files, and no shared owner integration. Seven Fable 5.1 coauthor/review assignments target pure-module and test-heavy packets; owner keeps fixture inspection, consumer install rehearsal and the milestone ledger. # Nisi v0.2 private packet cluster (proposal, unverified)

Principle: every packet adds files only (new tests/harness/manifest/pure module), one writer, single allowlisted commands, scoped regression green before start, new acceptance red before / green after. Nothing here touches the 225 frozen hashed files, existing dirty edits, or historical failed packets. No packet is an execution queue or publication trigger.

## Ten-row scope/dependency table

| # | Packet | Milestone | Scope (exact additions) | Deterministic acceptance | Depends on | Writer / Fable role |
|---|--------|-----------|-------------------------|--------------------------|------------|---------------------|
| P01 | Overlay-failure diagnostic harness | baseline (1780/1782) | New test file that reruns the 2 native-overlay tests under a capture wrapper and emits a structured diagnostic record (env, overlay path, type-prereq state, error class). No fix attempted. | New check fails (no record schema) before; passes after. Scoped regression: portable suite minus overlay. | none | OpenCode writer; Fable reviews |
| P02 | NX04 fixture ledger | NX04 | Manifest of inspected repository fixtures with hashes; classification of every author/reviewer callback as `fixture` vs `live` (all currently `fixture`). Read-only checker. | Ledger check fails before (missing manifest); passes after. | none | Owner-led writer (requires fixture inspection); no Fable |

No native reconstruction, no authority. | Recovery tests fail before; pass after. Assert "saved observations cannot authorize learning" as a test. | none | OpenCode; Fable coauthor |
| P04 | NX06 matched-trial record schema + adjudication validator | NX06 | Pure schema + validator for trial pairs, independent-adjudicator identity field (must differ from author/reviewer), reversibility flag. Test pins learning default OFF. | Validator tests fail before; pass after. No real trials run. | none | OpenCode; Fable coauthor |

Parallelism: P01–P06, P08–P10 are file-disjoint and can run concurrently; P07 waits on P10's hash list. Shared integration (wiring P05/P06 into coordinator/registry, using P03 in native storage) is deferred to owner-led reviewed work after exact candidate review.

## Seven Fable 5.1 assignments (≈70%)
1. P01 — review diagnostic record schema; verify no overlay "fix" slipped in.
2. P03 — coauthor recovery classifier + fixtures.
3. P04 — coauthor trial schema/adjudicator validator.
4. P05 — coauthor drain state table + fixtures.
5. P06 — coauthor activation predicate.
6. P08 — coauthor credit-labeling field/tests.
7. P09 — coauthor readiness honesty fields.
(P02, P07, P10 stay owner-led or owner-reviewed: they require fixture inspection, real install, or authority over the milestone ledger.)

## What ten packets cannot complete
- NX04: live-model real-repository demo and execution isolation.
- NX05: native reconstruction, crash-safe recovery in the real store, authenticated authority.
- NX06: real matched trials, independent adjudication, reversible influence acceptance.
- NX07: native/process/provider wiring, signed install, app integration, live user acceptance.
- NX08: plugin/traveler/graph integration and accepted controlled activation.
- NX09: exact-tree acceptance, real install rehearsal, matched OFF/ON evaluation, usefulness evaluation.
- NX10: external engineering/legal release decision.
- Overlay failure root cause (P01 only makes it diagnosable).
Milestone credit stays 30% until owners accept those gates; these packets change readiness, not the percentage.

## Cautions (5)
1. Do not let "harness"/"validator" packets be relabeled as milestone completion; they are preparatory and milestone count remains 3/10.
2. Any packet touching frozen files or re-pinning hashes must be rejected; P10's check should be the first packet merged.
3. P08/P09 modify existing bridge/readiness output shapes—confirm no consumer of the 141 checks depends on exact old shape; otherwise split into additive fields only.
4. Same-Qwen author/reviewer remains self-review; Fable coauthoring does not itself confer independent review credit unless the owner records it as such.
5. Do not run packets while concurrent users hold resident models; no hot-swap, no automatic model management.
